summary: Version 0.18.0 is live (release 0e1056f3a18b, CI green; /health shows the session watcher closed on a Sunday with no request made). The portfolio page has an IN SESSION panel: for each open position, simulated or real, a recent Yahoo Finance price and its time (MARKET, may be delayed), the change since entry in % and R, the distance to stop and target, and a flag with a word and a mark (target reached, stop reached, near stop within half an ATR). Prices are read every five minutes from 9:30 to 16:00 Toronto, at most ten symbols, never outside those hours; a price counts only with shares traded, in CAD, for the symbol asked, on the day it is read; otherwise the last close, named as such. Display only: the simulation stays on daily bars. No notifications, at the owner's request. The owner approved the screenshots before release.
